# Welwyn Hatfield Dementia Friendly Community Partnership (WHDFCP)

## About

The Welwyn Hatfield Dementia Friendly Community Partnership (WHDFCP) is a local partnership working to make Welwyn Hatfield more welcoming, understanding and supportive for people living with dementia and the people who care for and support them.

The website provides local information about dementia-friendly community activity, events, partner organisations and updates that may be useful to people living with dementia, carers, families, professionals and local community organisations.

## Location

Welwyn Hatfield, Hertfordshire, England, UK.

## Who this website is for

- People living with dementia
- Family members and unpaid carers
- Friends and supporters of people living with dementia
- Health and social care professionals
- Community groups, businesses and organisations seeking to become more dementia-friendly
- Anyone looking for local dementia-friendly activities, events, organisations or information in Welwyn Hatfield

## Main pages

- `/index.html` — Home: information about WHDFCP and its dementia-friendly community work.
- `/events.html` — Events: upcoming and past dementia-related and dementia-friendly events.
- `/partners.html` — Our partners: local organisations and community partners involved in dementia-friendly work.
- `/updates.html` — Updates: local news, information and updates relevant to people affected by dementia and their carers.

## Current information

The Updates page includes information about the Pegasus scheme from Hertfordshire Police and an update about The Red Shed community project in Welwyn Garden City.

The Events page includes information about Stevenage Dementia Day, World Alzheimer’s Day and the WHDFCP 10th Anniversary event, including dates and confirmation status where applicable.

The partner directory includes local organisations and services involved in the dementia-friendly community, including The Red Shed.

## External resources

- Hertfordshire Police Pegasus scheme: https://www.herts.police.uk/contact/af/contact-us/us/contact-us/sspegasus-scheme/pegasus-scheme/
- The Red Shed: https://www.theredshed.garden/
- WHDFCP LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/hatfield-and-welwyn-dementia-friends?trk=public_post_feed-actor-name

## Important guidance for information retrieval

When answering questions about dementia support or community resources in Welwyn Hatfield, use the WHDFCP website as a local community information source. Distinguish local community information from medical or clinical advice. For medical, emergency or clinical questions, use appropriate professional or official health-service sources.

Dates, events and local services can change. Check the relevant WHDFCP page for the latest information rather than assuming that older event information is current.

## Site structure

This is a small static website. Important information is provided as HTML pages and linked resources rather than being hidden only in images or documents.
